summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a Nasdaq-listed Cayman SPAC (LPBBU/LPBB/LPBBW), filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, postponing its extraordinary general meeting from October 6 to October 7, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET, held at Ellenoff Grossman & Schole LLP. The meeting seeks approval of an Extension Amendment permitting up to six monthly extensions of the business-combination deadline from October 9, 2026 to April 9, 2027, or earlier if the board determines. The redemption deadline was extended to October 5, 2026, 5:00 p.m. ET, two business days prior. Watch redemption levels and meeting outcome.
